display.label: Subnet
display.description: Azure Subnet within a Virtual Network for dividing network traffic and isolating workloads

resource.key_description: The unique name for the Azure Subnet. Serves as the map key.

sections.label: Basic Configuration
sections.description: Core Subnet identity, network placement, and CIDR allocation.

fields.label: Subnet Name
fields.description: Name of the Azure Subnet. Must be between 1 and 80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, and contain only alphanumerics, underscores, hyphens, and periods.

validation.pattern_error: Subnet name must be 1-80 characters, begin with an alphanumeric character, end with an alphanumeric character or underscore, and contain only alphanumerics, hyphens, periods, or underscores.

fields.label: Resource Group Name
fields.description: The Azure Resource Group containing the Virtual Network.

fields.label: Virtual Network Name
fields.description: The Virtual Network in which to create the Subnet.

fields.label: Address Prefixes (CIDR)
fields.description: The address prefixes for the Subnet in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.0.1.0/24).

sections.label: Endpoints & Network Policies
sections.description: Configure service endpoints, endpoint policies, and private link settings.

fields.label: Service Endpoints
fields.description: List of service endpoints to associate with the Subnet (e.g. Microsoft.Storage, Microsoft.Sql, Microsoft.KeyVault).

fields.label: Service Endpoint Policy IDs
fields.description: List of Service Endpoint Policy IDs to associate with this Subnet.

fields.label: Private Endpoint Network Policies
fields.description: Enable or disable network policies for private endpoints in this Subnet.

fields.label: Private Link Service Network Policies Enabled
fields.description: Enable or disable network policies for private link service in this Subnet.

sections.label: Subnet Delegation
sections.description: Delegate this Subnet to an Azure service (e.g., App Service or Container Instances).

fields.label: Service Delegation
fields.description: Subnet delegation configuration for dedicated services.

fields.label: Service Name
fields.description: The service name for delegation (e.g. Microsoft.Web/serverFarms, Microsoft.ContainerInstance/containerGroups).

fields.label: Delegation Actions
fields.description: Actions granted to the delegated service.
